source: disposable rebuild of database/migrations (relations in public and agent_audit except the chat and job journals; the allow-listed business functions)
notes: PostgreSQL 18, search_path pg_catalog, public; quote mixed-case identifiers exactly as written ("Loans"."Row ID"). Business dates are Asia/Bangkok. Call only the functions listed here; anything that modifies data fails in the read-only transaction.

functions.purpose: The earliest business date in the data.
functions.use_when: "Since when do we have records".

functions.purpose: Parses [daily, principal] from a loan's "Loan Arrangement" note.
functions.use_when: Only for an old loan's original basis.

functions.purpose: Renders a basis as the standard note.
functions.use_when: Rarely; formatting only.

functions.purpose: A cash holder's active default account id.
functions.use_when: Which account receives by default.

functions.purpose: How much of this month's net profit counts as settled under FIFO.
functions.use_when: Partner settlement questions only.

functions.purpose: First-day charge split (principal share; interest incl. transfer fee) for a Loans row; empty if none.
functions.use_when: Explaining the net-off at disbursement: SELECT * FROM "Loans" l, public.first_day_components_v83(l).

functions.function: public.forecast_scenario_v1(ui numeric, up numeric, oi numeric, op numeric, ci numeric, cp numeric, rr numeric, scenario text)
functions.purpose: Planning/Schedule/Stress projection of remaining interest and principal from the reporting_forecast_loans_v1 columns ui, up, oi, op and collection percentages.
functions.use_when: "What if only N% is collected".

functions.function: public.forecast_schedule_v1(l jsonb, charges jsonb, t date, e date)
functions.result: TABLE(due_date date, origin text, bucket text, principal numeric, interest numeric, eligible boolean, issue text)
functions.purpose: Simulates a loan's due dates and amounts from t to e (at most 93 days), recorded vs projected, with issues.
functions.use_when: Prefer oltp_upcoming_charge_events_v1 or reporting_forecast_events_v1, which call it; use directly only for a non-today window.

functions.purpose: The system's Loan Close calculation for an open, auto-enabled Daily Interest loan on p_day (amount, allocations, mutation, planHash); raises P0001 for any other loan.
functions.use_when: Cross-checking the charge-balance payoff (business rules section 6) through the loan_payoff tool; call directly only for a date other than today.

functions.function: public.loan_close_calculation_v83(p_loan text, p_day date, p_exclude_payment text)
functions.purpose: The same payoff computed as if closing payment p_exclude_payment did not exist (correction preview).
functions.use_when: "What would the payoff have been without payment X".

functions.purpose: Today in Bangkok as the reporting date.
functions.use_when: Every "as of today" filter.

functions.purpose: Whole-percent daily rate frozen at creation (historical=true reconstructs it from the note or first charge); NULL without evidence.
functions.use_when: Explaining why the daily amount changed after a principal payment.

functions.purpose: A Partner's net profit to date (interest share minus expense share).
functions.use_when: "How much has Tommy/Lisa earned"; pair with reporting_partner_position_v1.

functions.purpose: A Partner role's (A/B) capital share of the pool on a date; raises if the pool is not positive.
functions.use_when: Explaining an expense or profit split on a date.

functions.result: TABLE(charge text, loan text, charge_day date, principal numeric, interest numeric)
functions.purpose: The charges a Payments row is eligible to pay under its allocation method, with remaining principal/interest.
functions.use_when: "Why did payment X pay these charges" or previewing a Processing payment.

functions.purpose: A payment's financial inputs as an array.
functions.use_when: Comparing a payment before/after a correction.

functions.purpose: Clamps an assessment window to valid dates.
functions.use_when: Rarely.

functions.purpose: A holder's current balance and per-account balances.
functions.use_when: Current cash held by Tommy/Lisa (or "Cash Account Balances").

functions.purpose: The per-charge plan the app posted for payment p_id; NULL when none.
functions.use_when: "How was this app payment split across charges".

functions.result: TABLE(job_name text, business_date date, scope_key text, state text, started_at timestamp with time zone, completed_at timestamp with time zone, result_count bigint)
functions.purpose: State of the daily charge and analytics jobs per business date
functions.use_when: Whether charges were generated for a date; why a day's charges are missing
functions.comment: mw-access:governance read-only job status for the chat SQL tool

functions.purpose: Normalises plan lines.
functions.use_when: Only with pwa_effective_payment_plan_v2.

functions.purpose: The account a borrower should pay into.
functions.use_when: "Where should borrower X transfer".

functions.result: TABLE(borrower_id text, borrower_label text, hidden_flag boolean, has_active_loan boolean, active_loans bigint, loan_count bigint, first_loan_date date, last_payment_date date, outstanding_principal numeric, lifetime_interest numeric, principal_issued numeric, principal_returned numeric, interest_received numeric, loans_issued bigint, first_loans bigint, repeat_loans bigint, unclassified_loans bigint, principal_share numeric, interest_share numeric, principal_rank bigint, interest_rank bigint, invalid_fact_count bigint, reporting_date date, calculated_at timestamp with time zone)
functions.purpose: Per-borrower facts for a Bangkok date range (principal issued/returned, interest received, loans issued, first vs repeat, shares, ranks); p_population defaults to 'All with loan history'.
functions.use_when: Period rankings, e.g. "who paid most interest in September".
functions.comment: Read-only borrower period facts: explicit Bangkok dates, current cohort, signed receipts, immutable keys. Current positions do not reconstruct past balances. No AppSheet binding.

functions.function: public.reporting_cash_period(p_from date, p_to date, p_scope text)
functions.result: TABLE("Period Start" date, "Period End" date, "Account" text, "Available From" date, "Opening Balance" numeric, "Money In" numeric, "Money Out" numeric, "Net Movement" numeric, "Closing Balance" numeric, "Transaction Count" bigint, "Statement Status" text)
functions.purpose: Cash-account period totals; p_scope is a "Cash Accounts"."Row ID" or '__ALL__'.
functions.use_when: "Cash in/out for account X this month".
functions.comment: Live bounded period totals with fresh opening seed from source ledger. No daily history grid, snapshot seed or FIFO.

functions.purpose: The transactions behind reporting_cash_period, with running balances.
functions.use_when: Listing cash movements.
functions.comment: Live opening seed then running balances only over selected transactions; unknown/pre-opening balances stay NULL.

functions.purpose: Decodes a "Selected Charge IDs" list.
functions.use_when: Joining Selected Charges payments to charges.

functions.result: TABLE(interest numeric, principal numeric, n integer, outstanding numeric, active_interest numeric, daily numeric, closed boolean, active boolean)
functions.purpose: One borrower row: interest received, principal lent, loan count, outstanding principal, interest on open loans, daily interest, has closed/open loans.
functions.use_when: A one-call borrower summary when olap_borrowers_analytics is more than needed.

functions.result: TABLE(pp numeric, ip numeric, total numeric, pr numeric, ir numeric, remaining numeric, n integer, status text, paid_date date)
functions.purpose: A charge's paid and remaining principal/interest, repayment count, status and last paid date, computed from repayments.
functions.use_when: Cross-checking trigger balances; usually the Charges columns suffice.

functions.purpose: Current daily interest earned by an open auto-charged loan (Daily: the daily amount; Installment: interest share per day; else 0).
functions.use_when: "Interest per day" for a loan or a borrower total.

columns.name: Borrower Note
columns.comment: Optional persistent borrower note, edited in OLTP collection detail. Informational only; does not change payment terms or balances.

relations.comment: Incurred expenses, no payment status. SQL recalculates allocations from historical contributions; referral transaction identity is immutable. No historical backfill.

R016 reconstructed Bangkok account/date snapshots. Hourly yesterday/today; explicit history rebuild for older corrections. Not a live cash source. Pre-opening balances stay NULL. Current immutable account ownership is joined for display.
R010 latest 15 Bangkok dates. Running balances use all prior ledger effects and immutable R008 opening/baseline offsets. NULL without initialization.

columns.name: Alternative Account Number
columns.comment: Optional second bank account or PromptPay number mapped to this cash account; receipt matching must reject ambiguous matches.

relations.comment: R014 read-only Bangkok MTD: signed income/expenses, completed per-partner FIFO withdrawals from inception, net unsettled profit, available contributed capital and positive initialized account custody. Role A=Tommy, B=Lisa. Unknown account openings keep business cash unavailable. No base-data writes.
R010 UI state only. AppSheet UPDATES_ONLY; signed-in Partner security filter; only account/date editable. No financial posting.

columns.name: Pending Charges EOD
columns.comment: Model 3: sum per-charge max(principal due + interest due - dated posted principal/interest payments,0), for charges due through snapshot date. Includes partially paid charges; historical corrections restate snapshots.

columns.name: Available Cash EOD
columns.comment: Remaining lending capital = signed contributed capital minus dated outstanding principal. NOT actual account cash.

columns.name: Partner Settlements
columns.comment: Completed settlements on Transfer Date; excludes Pending and Cancelled. Actual dated payments, not FIFO profit-period allocation.

columns.name: Cash Balance EOD
columns.comment: Signed sum of account closing balances, including negatives. NULL unless all current accounts have a known opening by this date.

columns.name: Interest Schedule Anchor Date
columns.comment: Optional daily-interest schedule origin. First subsequent scheduled charge is anchor plus Interest Payment Interval. NULL uses Loan Date. Does not reset interest accrual or change existing charges.

columns.name: Ref Closing Payment
columns.comment: Payment that changed this loan from open to closed. SQL-owned; NULL for pre-migration or non-payment closure. No historical inference/backfill.

columns.name: Charge Generation Request
columns.comment: Manual generation command: Bangkok YYYY-MM-DD|unique token. Hidden and user-read-only in AppSheet; SQL derives charge components. Latest command only, not a financial ledger.

columns.name: Original Daily Interest Rate
columns.comment: Original average daily interest / original principal * 100, rounded to integer percentage points (1 means 1%). Frozen at creation. NULL means original terms unavailable.

columns.name: Email
columns.comment: Notification delivery address; may be shared. Never use this field to identify/exclude the actor.

columns.name: Login Email
columns.comment: Unique AppSheet sign-in identity; independent of notification Email. Null means no login mapping.

columns.name: AI Reviewer
columns.comment: Receives and decides AI payment reviews. Does not control daily summaries or Instagram integration. Initial reviewer: Tommy.

columns.name: Ref Target Loan
columns.comment: Loan Close command target. AppSheet submits the loan; SQL prepares final charges and computes the receipt before unified posting. NULL for other methods and historical receipts.

columns.name: IG Receipt ID
columns.comment: Service-owned primary asset ID in mw_agent; not an AppSheet Ref

columns.name: Receipt Image
columns.comment: Bucket-root AppSheet GCS reference: // followed by the immutable object key

columns.name: Receipt Received At
columns.comment: Durable ingress capture in Asia/Bangkok; not bank transfer time

columns.name: Selected Charge IDs
columns.comment: Selected Charges command scope: canonical comma-separated immutable Charge keys. SQL validates every key and posts FK-backed allocations atomically. NULL for other methods.

columns.name: Uploaded Receipt
columns.comment: Optional user-uploaded GCS image via AppSheet; agent-owned Receipt Image remains protected

columns.name: Uploaded Receipt At
columns.comment: Server-maintained Asia/Bangkok time of the latest user image addition or replacement; null after removal

columns.name: Analytics Refresh Request
columns.comment: OLAP command: Bangkok request-date|Recent or Full|unique token. SQL refreshes daily snapshots atomically; not a financial ledger.

Partner B Contribution at Payment Date

R028: automatic schedule gate preserves V41 payment score and contribution. V2 retained for rollback/comparison; no borrower names or override records.
